subject: Pilot billing route & invoice requirements (PO vs card, net terms)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@electricai.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot billing route & invoice requirements — follow up

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can align Redwood finance and Legal on the pilot paperwork: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement typically requires a PO for pilots (vs charging a card). Can you confirm whether this will be a one-off PO for the initial pilot or a standing PO/net schedule?
- Net terms: you said Net45 might be standard — please confirm if Net30/45/60 is acceptable and whether ElectricAI requires any special invoicing cadence (monthly in arrears, milestone-based, etc.).
- Invoice format: finance needs to know required line items (SKU, description, unit price, quantity), tax/VAT handling, and whether ElectricAI requires the PO number printed on the invoice PDF.
- Billing address & tax details: please send the exact remit/billing address, company legal name, and VAT/GST or EIN if applicable.
- Marketplace interest: you mentioned evaluating marketplace channels later — is the initial purchase expected to be off-marketplace (direct) or should we prepare a marketplace pricing/terms option as well?

I attached our blank invoice template to speed validation (Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx). If you can reply with: (1) sample PO or PO process PDF, (2) billing/contact email, and (3) VAT/EIN info, I’ll loop in our commercial team and get a formal quote + SOW ready.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx
From: Anna Li <anna@electricai.com>

Cc: Mike Connors <mike.connors@electricai.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot billing route & invoice requirements — follow up

Hi Sean —

Great to recap — here are the specifics from procurement: 

- Procurement path: ElectricAI prefers a PO for anything over $5k; for this pilot we will route a single PO that covers the initial three-month pilot.
- Net terms: Net45 is our standard for vendor invoices.
- Invoice format: Our AP system requires a PDF invoice with the PO number on the header, line-level SKUs, and a separate tax line if VAT applies. Please include Redwood company legal name and Redwood’s remit address on the invoice.
- Billing address / tax:
  Company name: ElectricAI, Inc.
  Remit address: 210 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107
  EIN: 94-1234567
  VAT/GST: N/A (US entity)
- Billing contact / submission: Please send invoices to procurement@electricai.com. PO number will be issued within 48 hours once Legal signs the SOW.
- Marketplace: we are exploring the cloud marketplace for longer-term purchases, but for the pilot we prefer a direct purchase and PO.

Attaching our PO intake/process doc and a copy of our W-9 for reference.

Thanks —
Anna Li
Head of Procurement
ElectricAI
anna@electricai.com

Attachments: ElectricAI_PO_Process.pdf, ElectricAI_W9.pdf

Anna —

Appreciate the fast turn. Copying Karhtik (commercial/finance) and Monica (CS/onboarding) so we can get everything queued. Quick notes: 

- Redwood can support PO-based billing and Net45. We typically require a one-time credit & compliance check for Net terms; Karhtik, can you confirm any documentation needed?
- We'll send a SOW + invoice that includes the PO number once provided. Monica will prepare onboarding dates conditional on PO issuance.
- Karhtik — I attached our invoice template; if ElectricAI’s AP requires any additional fields we’ll update.

Anna, could you confirm the email to which we should send the final invoice PDF (procurement@electricai.com confirmed) and whether your PO will include a Billing Code or Cost Center that needs to appear on the invoice? Also let us know if the PO will be issued before or after Legal signs the SOW.

Thanks,
Sean

Thanks — looping in next steps from finance side: 

1) Credit & vendor onboarding: We’ll run our standard onboarding and credit check for Net45. We typically need a signed SOW + W9 (thanks for providing) and the PO when available.
2) Invoice delivery: please confirm the exact procurement email (procurement@electricai.com) — we’ll send the final invoice PDF to that address and cc accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com for tracking.
